title: Resilient degree sharpness function
statement: Let $n,k$ be natural numbers with $k<n-1$. Define a sign-valued function on sign vectors of length $n$ by taking the parity on the prefix of coordinates $0,1,\ldots,k$ and multiplying it by the sign encoding of the binary monomial supported on the complementary tail coordinates.
